request_flow: User enters through stable door pmp-app-current.html.

Route Guardian v14 waits for manual Open Latest App, then loads current app and injects support scripts.
v3 wrapper loads pmp-home-single-v6.html and injects Resident/X-Ray/lossless/work/source/private-window support scripts.
User types into textarea#ask and presses Run.
Patched residentRun layers may run first: X-Ray context refresh, lossless readiness interception, work-copy/copy-lossless support.
If no wrapper intercepts, original residentRun reads ask/paste/localStorage/sessionStorage and routes by local regex/keyword rules.
Resident creates a local reply/report/handoff packet and writes output to reply/work/warning elements and local/session storage.
reply_flow: Original Resident writes through plain(), setStatus(), residentReply, residentWarning, residentWork, session chat, and pmp_single_resident_work_v6.
X-Ray wrapper writes pmp_resident_xray_context_v1, pmp_resident_xray_rule_v1, and pmp_resident_xray_history_v1.
Lossless readiness wrapper writes readiness reports to residentReply/residentWork and pmp_resident_lossless_readiness_latest_v1.
Work-copy patch replaces showWork/copyWork behavior for visible diagnostic copying.
Top-shell lossless builders can build/copy a vault write packet and open the PMP Vault GitHub Writer Shortcut.
Safe Writer and Code Safety docks output local JSON/template responses and handoffs.
